atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(20, "Coil Length", 5, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 100, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 100, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.70, "Coil Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
predThresh = input(0.35, "Predictability Threshold", 0.05, 0.9, 0.05)
releaseMult = input(1.50, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trInner = max(tr2, tr3)
tr = max(tr1, trInner)
a = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
r = high - low
minR = lowest(r, coilLen)
maxR = highest(r, coilLen)
coilRange = max(maxR, 0.00000001)
coilLoad = 1 - minR / coilRange
maxA = highest(a, vovLen)
minA = lowest(a, vovLen)
minAGuard = max(minA, 0.00000001)
vov = (maxA - minA) / minAGuard
vovRising = vov > vov[1]
chgAbs = abs(close - close[1])
chgSigned = close - close[1]
tot = sma(chgAbs, predLen) * predLen
net = abs(sma(chgSigned, predLen) * predLen)
predictable = tot > 0 ? net / tot : 0
rPrev = r[1]
aPrev = a[1]
releaseExp = r > rPrev * releaseMult and a > aPrev
coilPrev = coilLoad[1]
vovPrev = vov[1]
vovPrev2 = vov[2]
loadedPrev = coilPrev > coilThresh
vovWasRising = vovPrev > vovPrev2
bullBar = close > open
bearBar = close < open
isPred = predictable > predThresh
buySig = loadedPrev and vovWasRising and releaseExp and bullBar and isPred
sellSig = loadedPrev and vovWasRising and releaseExp and bearBar and isPred
loadedNow = coilLoad > coilThresh
loadedUnpred = loadedNow and not isPred and vovRising
loadedPred = loadedNow and isPred and vovRising

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if vovRising { bgcolor("#b48cff", "separate") }
if loadedPred { bgcolor("#ffaa2233", "separate") }
if loadedUnpred { bgcolor("#4488ff33", "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictable, "Predictable", "#ffd43b", 2, "separate")
plot(vov, "VoV", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(predThresh, "#ffd43b", "separate")

plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictable, "Predictable 3D", "line3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vov, "VoV 3D", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate") }

sessionStartHour = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
sessionLengthHours = input(8, "Session Length Hours", 1, 24, 1)
lookback1hSwings = input(3, "1H Swing Lookback", 1, 20, 1)
confirmationBars1h = input(2, "1H Confirmation Bars", 1, 10, 1)
minDisplacementPct = input(0.15, "Min Displacement %", 0.01, 5.0, 0.01)
stopBufferTicks = input(5, "Stop Buffer Ticks", 0, 100, 1)

sessBars = sessionLengthHours * 12 + sessionStartHour + 12
sessionHigh = highest(high, sessBars)
sessionLow = lowest(low, sessBars)

hHigh = security("1h", high)
hLow = security("1h", low)
hClose = security("1h", close)

winSpan = lookback1hSwings * 2 + 1
winHigh = highest(hHigh, winSpan)
winLow = lowest(hLow, winSpan)
centerH = hHigh[lookback1hSwings]
centerL = hLow[lookback1hSwings]
newFractalHigh = centerH == winHigh and centerH > 0
newFractalLow = centerL == winLow and centerL > 0

var lastSH = 0.0
var lastSL = 0.0
var lastBuyBar = -1000000.0
var lastSellBar = -1000000.0

if newFractalHigh {
    lastSH := centerH
}
if newFractalLow {
    lastSL := centerL
}

htfValid = hClose > 0 and lastSH > 0 and lastSL > 0
bullBreak = htfValid and hClose > lastSH
bearBreak = htfValid and hClose < lastSL
bullHold = htfValid and lowest(hClose, confirmationBars1h) > lastSH
bearHold = htfValid and highest(hClose, confirmationBars1h) < lastSL
bullConfirmed = bullBreak and bullHold
bearConfirmed = bearBreak and bearHold

oppFreeBull = lowest(hClose, confirmationBars1h) > lastSL
oppFreeBear = highest(hClose, confirmationBars1h) < lastSH

dispBullRaw = (hClose - lastSH) / lastSH * 100
dispBearRaw = (lastSL - hClose) / lastSL * 100
dispBull = htfValid ? dispBullRaw : 0.0
dispBear = htfValid ? dispBearRaw : 0.0

normBull = dispBull / (minDisplacementPct * 4.0)
normBear = dispBear / (minDisplacementPct * 4.0)
cappedBull = normBull > 1.0 ? 1.0 : normBull
cappedBear = normBear > 1.0 ? 1.0 : normBear
confBullRaw = cappedBull + 0.2
confBearRaw = cappedBear + 0.2
confBull = confBullRaw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : confBullRaw
confBear = confBearRaw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : confBearRaw

longTrigger = crossover(close, sessionHigh[1])
shortTrigger = crossunder(close, sessionLow[1])

rawLong = longTrigger and bullConfirmed and oppFreeBull and dispBull >= minDisplacementPct
rawShort = shortTrigger and bearConfirmed and oppFreeBear and dispBear >= minDisplacementPct

buySig = rawLong and bar_index - lastBuyBar[1] > 20
sellSig = rawShort and bar_index - lastSellBar[1] > 20

bearEdge = bearConfirmed and not bearConfirmed[1]
bullEdge = bullConfirmed and not bullConfirmed[1]
exitLongTrig = crossunder(close, sessionHigh[1])
exitShortTrig = crossover(close, sessionLow[1])
exitLongSig = exitLongTrig or bearEdge
exitShortSig = exitShortTrig or bullEdge

tickEst = close * 0.0001
stopLongPrice = sessionLow - stopBufferTicks * tickEst
stopShortPrice = sessionHigh + stopBufferTicks * tickEst

if buySig {
    lastBuyBar := bar_index
    model.confidence(confBull)
    model.stopLoss(stopLongPrice, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Siege Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    lastSellBar := bar_index
    model.confidence(confBear)
    model.stopLoss(stopShortPrice, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Siege Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "xcross", "#ffcc33")
}
if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "xcross", "#33ccff")
}

plot(sessionHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessionLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

brkLow = lowest(low, brkLen)[1]

if buySig {

}

plot(brkLow, "Breakout Low", "#ff4477", 1)
plot(momPct, "Momentum Pct", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6 Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2 Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50.0 Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)

hh = highest(high, lookback)
ll = lowest(low, lookback)

lvl236 = ll + rng * f236
lvl382 = ll + rng * f382
lvl50 = ll + rng * f50

buySig = crossover(close, lvl618)

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {

plot(lvl618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(lvl382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast RV Len", 2, 60, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium RV Len", 5, 100, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow RV Len", 10, 200, 1)
skewLen = input(30, "Skew Range Len", 5, 200, 1)
compressLookback = input(50, "Compression Lookback", 10, 200, 1)
expandPct = input(15.0, "Expansion %", 1.0, 100.0, 0.5)
skewBull = input(0.2, "Skew Bull Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)
skewBear = input(-0.2, "Skew Bear Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
sqrt365 = sqrt(365)
fastRV = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt365
medRV = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt365
slowRV = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt365
HH = highest(high, skewLen)
LL = lowest(low, skewLen)
eps = 0.000000001
rawSkew = (close - LL) / (HH - LL + eps) * 2 - 1
skew = rawSkew
if rawSkew > 1 {
    skew = 1
}
if rawSkew < -1 {
    skew = -1
}
spreadFastSlow = fastRV - slowRV
slopeMid = medRV - slowRV
contangoFlag = fastRV < medRV and medRV < slowRV
compLow = lowest(fastRV, compressLookback)
compressed = fastRV <= compLow * 1.02
wasCompressed = compressed[1] or compressed[2] or compressed[3] or compressed[4] or compressed[5]
expanded = fastRV >= compLow * (1 + expandPct / 100) and fastRV > fastRV[1] and wasCompressed
flipBull = skew[1] <= 0 and skew > skewBull
flipBear = skew[1] >= 0 and skew < skewBear

var lastBuyBar = -1000
var lastSellBar = -1000
rawBuy = expanded and flipBull
rawSell = expanded and flipBear
buySig = rawBuy and bar_index - lastBuyBar > 20
sellSig = rawSell and bar_index - lastSellBar > 20
if buySig {
    lastBuyBar := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
    lastSellBar := bar_index
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastRV, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastRV, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(spreadFastSlow, "Spread Fast-Slow", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
plot(slopeMid, "Slope Mid-Slow", "#ff5577", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
hline(skewBull, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(skewBear, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(medRV, "Term Manifold", "manifold", "#8a5cf6", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastRV, "Front Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)
plot3d(spreadFastSlow, "Spread Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
maxScale = input(100, "Max Scale", 10, 200, 1)
baseThickness = input(1, "Base Thickness", 0.5, 3, 0.1)
maxThickness = input(5, "Max Thickness", 1, 10, 0.1)
buyLevel = input(70, "Buy Level", 0, 100, 1)
sellLevel = input(30, "Sell Level", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift1 = (close - close[1]) * 0.3
drift2 = (close - close[1]) * 0.5
drift3 = (close - close[1]) * 0.7
drift4 = (close - close[1]) * 0.9
drift5 = (close - close[1]) * 1.1
c1 = max(0, min(100, ch1 + drift1))
c2 = max(0, min(100, ch2 + drift2))
c3 = max(0, min(100, ch3 + drift3))
c4 = max(0, min(100, ch4 + drift4))
c5 = max(0, min(100, ch5 + drift5))
h1 = c1 / 100 * maxScale
h2 = c2 / 100 * maxScale
h3 = c3 / 100 * maxScale
h4 = c4 / 100 * maxScale
h5 = c5 / 100 * maxScale
avg = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5
avgH = avg / 100 * maxScale
curveThickness = baseThickness + (avg / 100) * (maxThickness - baseThickness)
splineH = (h1 + h2 * 2 + h3 * 2 + h4 * 2 + h5) / 7 + (close - open) * 0.05
thickPlot = curveThickness * 10 + (close - open) * 0.1
col1 = c1 > 70 ? "#22cc88" : c1 > 30 ? "#ffcc33" : "#ff4477"
col2 = c2 > 70 ? "#22cc88" : c2 > 30 ? "#ffcc33" : "#ff4477"
col3 = c3 > 70 ? "#22cc88" : c3 > 30 ? "#ffcc33" : "#ff4477"
col4 = c4 > 70 ? "#22cc88" : c4 > 30 ? "#ffcc33" : "#ff4477"
col5 = c5 > 70 ? "#22cc88" : c5 > 30 ? "#ffcc33" : "#ff4477"

var coolBuy = 0
var coolSell = 0
coolBuy := max(0, coolBuy - 1)
coolSell := max(0, coolSell - 1)
buyTrig = crossover(avg, buyLevel) and coolBuy == 0
sellTrig = crossunder(avg, sellLevel) and coolSell == 0
buySig = buyTrig
sellSig = sellTrig
any100 = c1 == 100 or c2 == 100 or c3 == 100 or c4 == 100 or c5 == 100
hi5 = highest(avg, 5)
lo5 = lowest(avg, 5)
newExtreme = avg >= hi5 or avg <= lo5
alertTrig = any100 or newExtreme
alertSig = alertTrig and not alertTrig[1]

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  coolBuy := 10
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  coolSell := 10
}
if alertSig {

}
if buySig {

if bar_index % 10 == 0 {

  plotshape_3d(bar_index, h3, "C3", "cube", col3, 0.8, 2, "separate")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, h4, "C4", "cube", col4, 0.8, 3, "separate")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, h5, "C5", "cube", col5, 0.8, 4, "separate")
}

wind_direction_vector_x = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
wind_direction_vector_y = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
wind_direction_vector_z = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
wind_speed_knots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
base_tail_length = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.1, 10.0, 0.1)
length_per_knot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
min_speed_knots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 0.5)
max_speed_knots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 1.0, 100.0, 0.5)
high_wind_alert_knots = input(30.0, "High Wind Alert Knots", 1.0, 100.0, 0.5)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

var prevYaw = 0.0
var prevPitch = 0.0
var lastNeutBar = -1000

vx = wind_direction_vector_x
vy = wind_direction_vector_y
vz = wind_direction_vector_z
spd = wind_speed_knots

m = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz)
mSafe = m == 0 ? 1.0 : m
nx = vx / mSafe
ny = vy / mSafe
nz = vz / mSafe
horiz = sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny)
horizSafe = horiz == 0 ? 1.0 : horiz
yawRaw = atan2(ny, nx)
pitchRaw = atan2(nz, horizSafe)
yawNow = m == 0 ? prevYaw : yawRaw
pitchNow = m == 0 ? prevPitch : pitchRaw
rollNow = 0.0
yawDeg = yawNow * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchNow * 57.29578
tailLen = base_tail_length + length_per_knot * spd
spanRange = max_speed_knots - min_speed_knots
spanSafe = spanRange == 0 ? 1.0 : spanRange
tRaw = (spd - min_speed_knots) / spanSafe
tLow = tRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : tRaw
tNorm = tLow > 1.0 ? 1.0 : tLow
rCh = tNorm
gCh = 0.5 * tNorm
bCh = 1.0 - tNorm
windColor = tNorm > 0.66 ? "#ff8000" : tNorm > 0.33 ? "#9966cc" : "#2266ff"
wob = (close - open) * 0.01
speedPlot = spd + wob
tailPlot = tailLen + wob
pitchPlot = pitchNow + wob * 0.05

prevYaw := yawNow
prevPitch := pitchNow

spdPrev = spd[1]
crossUp = spd > high_wind_alert_knots and spdPrev <= high_wind_alert_knots
buySig = crossUp and pitchNow > 0.0
sellSig = crossUp and pitchNow < 0.0
sx = vx > 0.0 ? 1.0 : vx < 0.0 ? -1.0 : 0.0
sy = vy > 0.0 ? 1.0 : vy < 0.0 ? -1.0 : 0.0
sz = vz > 0.0 ? 1.0 : vz < 0.0 ? -1.0 : 0.0
sxPrev = sx[1]
syPrev = sy[1]
szPrev = sz[1]
octChange = sx != sxPrev or sy != syPrev or sz != szPrev
octEdge = octChange and spd > min_speed_knots and bar_index - lastNeutBar > 10
neutralSig = octEdge and not buySig and not sellSig
if octEdge {
  lastNeutBar := bar_index
}

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Wind Up Alert", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Wind Down Alert", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if neutralSig {

}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Wind Up", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1.0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, 0.0)
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Wind Down", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1.0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, 0.0)
}
if neutralSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Octant", "diamond", "#ffaa00", 0.8 * markerSize, 2.0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, 0.0)
}

plot(speedPlot, "Wind Speed Knots", "#2266ff", 2, "separate")
plot(tailPlot, "Arrow Tail Length", "#ff8800", 2, "separate")
plot(pitchPlot, "Pitch", "#33ccaa", 1, "separate")
